title: Raw affine cohomology classes eventually vanish
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, k:W→S a scheme morphism, G a Λ-module sheaf on W_et, q∈ℤ, I a small cofiltered category, and D:I→Over W an inverse system with affine transition morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Assume every composite D(i)→S is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting, and assume c.pt→S is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For an affine etale U→S, write P_i(U)=Hom((D(i)→S)^*Λ[U][0],D(i)^*G[q]) and P_c(U)=Hom((c.pt→S)^*Λ[U][0],c.pt^*G[q]) in D⁺ of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For i∈I and z∈P_i(U), if its explicitly constructed raw pullback r_{c_i}(z) [sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-over-naturality] is zero in P_c(U), then there exist j∈I and f:j→i with r_{D(f)}(z)=0 in P_j(U). This is raw cohomology vanishing; it makes no assertion about arbitrary higher-image sheaf sections.

proof.text: Present I opposite by a small directed final category, preserving the underlying scheme limit by opposite initiality. Pull back the diagram and cone along U→S. The stages are qcqs because their structure maps to affine U are qcqs, transitions remain affine, and the cone remains limiting. Free-module-sheaf sections and etale restriction identify the displayed raw derived Hom with cohomology of these pullback schemes.

Composition of inverse images identifies the coefficient diagram on the limit with the constant diagram of c.pt^*G restricted to U. The filtered index is nonempty and connected, so this sheaf is its colimit. Place the stage sheaves in degree-zero complexes, with common lower bound zero. Compute their underlying abelian cohomology by injective module resolutions using all-object abelian section acyclicity. Apply complex cohomology continuity. Derived adjunction identifies the maps with the explicit raw pullbacks.

Apply the filtered group-colimit equality criterion to z and zero. The image of zero along every arrow is zero, so an arrow from the original stage kills z. Transport a witness in the directed presentation back to I and compose arrows. For q<0, degree-zero sheaf cohomology is zero and the identity stage suffices.

mathlib_searches.query: Injectivity of etale cohomology continuity under inverse limits with affine transition morphisms
mathlib_searches.results: Eight Mathlib hits: etale forgetful faithfulness, standard etale presentation injectivity, gluing and stalk-map injectivity. None supplies cohomology continuity. Repository raw-affine-class-rep and raw-affine-image-rep assert surjectivity, not eventual zero; affine-computation-vanishing concerns abelian sheaf sections and a directed preorder, not raw module derived Hom.

theorem exists_higher_image_raw_affine_class_eq_zero
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Over W)
    [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k)]
    [∀ i, QuasiSeparated ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget W).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact (c.pt.hom ≫ k)] [QuasiSeparated (c.pt.hom ≫ k)]
    (U : S.Etale) [IsAffine U.left] (i : I)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q (D.obj i)).obj (op U))
    (hz : higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q (c.π.app i) U z = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (f : j ⟶ i),
      higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q (D.map f) U z = 0
